note: Monthly figures from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data: median and 10th-90th percentile of standard-price residential sales (category A) by completion month, for England & Wales (all homes and by type, from 1995) and per local authority (council area or London borough, all homes, from 2009-01). Sales under £10,000 and over £25 million are left out. Sales reach the register weeks to months late, so the newest 2 months are not loaded.
